Fujian tongzhi (福建通志), Siku Quanshu recension, juan 11 - TAIWAN PREFECTURE SECTION
Date: 18th century. NOT VERIFIED from a title page; conventionally the 1737 edition
as taken into the Siku Quanshu. Treat the date as approximate.

Transcription: Chinese Wikisource
https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/福建通志 (四庫全書本)/卷11
revision id 2015769 (2021-01-30T02:23:26Z)
Retrieved 2026-08-30.

THIS IS NOT MAINLAND-FUJIAN EVIDENCE. Taiwan was administratively part of Fujian
until 1885, and BOTH tomato-relevant entries fall under the anchor 臺灣府 (Taiwan
Prefecture). Verified positionally in Python against every prefecture anchor in
the file, with a positive control on the term:
柑仔蜜 1 hit -> 臺灣府
番柿 1 hit -> 臺灣府
NOR can a mainland negative be claimed from this file: the prefecture anchors in
juan 11 begin at 延平府, so 福州府 / 泉州府 / 漳州府 / 興化府 are not in this juan at
all. Testing whether 柑仔蜜 reached mainland Fujian needs the other product juan.
NOT YET DONE.

The entries:
柑仔蜜 {形如柿，細如橘，可和糖煮茶品}
the tomato: shaped like a persimmon, small as a tangerine, can be boiled with
sugar as a tea delicacy
番柿 {形似柿，皮有毛，俗呼為毛柿，西域種}
THE FALSE FRIEND: Diospyros discolor, the hairy velvet apple - "the skin has
hair, commonly called maoshi, a species of the Western Regions". NOT the tomato.

THIS IS A TRANSCRIPTION, NOT A FACSIMILE.
